Best hotel in Saigon!
Apr 2026 • Couples
I cannot believe how special the staff at this amazing hotel make you feel. 
They are all delightful and we have left here with a strong desire to return very soon!
Previously we have stayed at the Intercontinental but now that Marriott have taken that over we have found a new favourite in the Indigo Saigon!

The Shipyard Bar has a wonderful cocktail list, very well thought out and curated and the passion of the staff makes them even more delicious!

If you are looking for a memorable experience then this is it! 

Highly highly recommend!

Perfectly relaxing stay
Apr 2026 • Couples
I really enjoy staying at Indigo Hotels. Been to a few over the world. This hotel is no exception… beautiful rooms and facilities. 

Food and drinks have also been great, great selection and taste. The staff can never do enough for you, always so helpful and friendly. 

Location is also perfect, and asking distance to many of the popular tourist sights here in Saigon. 

If I had to provide a wish list… a cosy seating area/ lounge for afternoon coffees or evening drinks. The bar is a little too formal to relax and enjoy an hour or so chilling.

This restaurant is one of the best run that we have seen. The training of the employees is fantastic and each of the attendants are courteous, friendly and helpful. While they are all worth mention, we have particularly enjoyed our morning conversations with Phuc, who always brings a smile and is quick to help us. 

The food is always hot and fresh and the cooking team is top notch.

Ship Ahoy
Mar 2026 • Couples
There are two distinct areas of the Shipyard one is the lower bar/dining area and then on the mezzanine floor is the breakfast dining area, both areas are extremely well decorated with well set tables. The bar area is relaxing to have a beer or two before wondering out for dinner with excellent service from the staff. Breakfast is buffet style with so much to choose from, it caters for all tastes and looks/tastes absolutely lovely, eggs are cooked to order and all staff are extremely welcoming with a smile to on their faces and are attentive when clearing tables and enquiring if they can get anything for you. Whilst all staff provide an absolutely brillant service with a smile on their faces a special thank you to Duy Pham who never seems to stop moving around the breakfast area.
